claim_definition: Verifies that the gate enforces a receipt at every intermediate step between T0 and T1. If the lineage chain has a gap (a missing receipt hash), the gate MUST DENY. The chain is not optional - it is required.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - continuous lineage enforcement test

test_cases.description: The gate must enforce a receipt at every intermediate step. A gap in the lineage chain MUST result in DENY.
